C1_overlap_dependence.detail: raw tail observations 30,392 -> 4,034 non-overlapping (7.53x). Under the corrected estimator the spread falls from -0.888 to -0.158, t -1.07, CI crossing zero.

C2_estimator_validity.detail: the unweighted block-mean estimator is biased when per-block observation counts are endogenous to the outcome, which they are here. Raw means give spread +0.039 where the block estimator gave -0.888.

C3_long_history_H1_analogue.detail: 23,422 independent observations over 16 years: spread +0.029, t +0.89, sign POSITIVE. No period or regime reaches abs(t) = 1.6.

C4_sign_stability.detail: disp_8_lag1 flips sign between TRAIN (-0.029) and DEV (+0.178) and across regimes.

C5_cost_realism.detail: the diagnostic hypothetical GROSS mean is already negative (-0.087 ATR, -$0.246) before any cost is applied, so cost sensitivity cannot rescue it.

C6_spread_convention.detail: round-turn spread cost is 1 x S ($0.33), not 2 x S. Earlier reports in this programme said 2 x S, which double-counted. Both conventions are reported throughout Phase 2.

phase1_status: HEADLINE RETRACTED -- no robust conditional structure
scope_of_retraction: The flawed estimator was used throughout the Phase 1 scan, so every t-statistic in phase1_structure_results.json is unreliable. The Phase 1 REJECTIONS are unaffected in substance -- the correction removes a false positive rather than creating new ones, and the corrected estimator finds nothing here either -- but a full re-run would be required to make that claim rigorously, and it has not been done.
